items.title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
items.summary: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.

items.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
items.summary: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.

items.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
items.summary: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.

items.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
items.summary: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.

items.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
items.summary: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.

items.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare

items.title: 2026 Birthday week: network performance update
items.summary: Cloudflare now ranks as the fastest provider across 74% of the top 1,000 global networks. By incorporating background telemetry from Cloudflare Challenge Pages, we have expanded our real-user measurement scale while maintaining user privacy.
